items.finding: DOOM3 gives genitive-dative definite «urdei» and permits plural «urde» for product sorts; «urdele» and «urdelor» are the corresponding regular articulated plural forms. They denote the dairy concept and do not introduce the compound plant «urda-vacii».
DOOM3 gives «telemelei» and permits «telemele» for product sorts; the two longer forms are regular definite/genitive plural forms. All retain the same brined-cheese referent.

DOOM3 prefers plural «mujdeie», and the DOR paradigm supplies «mujdeiului», «mujdeiele» and «mujdeielor». Rare «mujdeiuri» variants remain excluded. A rare adult argot homograph is not used by the content and does not dominate these culinary forms in a gastronomy context.
These are the regular genitive-dative definite singular and plural forms of «friptură» and retain the prepared-meat referent.
The singular and both case forms have correct noun-adjective agreement and denote an instance or inflected mention of the same fried-potato food concept.
DEX/MDA attest neutral plural «bulzuri». The retained «cu brânză» qualifier selects the food and preserves V72's exclusion of bare lump, rock, lumber and place readings.
DOOM3 supports the singular/plural/case paradigm. Because bare «cornuleț» has many horn, plant and figurative senses, every new form keeps «cu gem», which sources document as a normal pastry filling.
This is the regular definite singular plus agreeing adjective. «Prăjită» selects the pastry against lie, swelling, gall and cocoon senses, preserving the V72 qualifier rule.

collision_review.finding: No proposed surface resolves exactly or by projection to another owner. Existing fuzzy matches point only to the intended owner; unresolved forms become ordinary typed aliases. Unique technical ownership was not treated as semantic proof: ambiguous bare forms remain excluded or receive an explicit food qualifier.

limitation: This verifies Romanian form and same-referent safety for the exact frozen list. It does not classify the forms as new synonyms, approve additional bare forms, or replace collision, reconstruction and all-game resolution tests.
